oneLineEn: Brought the historical life-world into method via Geisteswissenschaften, Erlebnis, and Verstehen.
oneLineZh: 以精神科学、体验和理解理论把历史生命世界纳入哲学方法论。

oneLineEn: Extended hermeneutics from method to ontology via effective history, fusion of horizons, and linguisticality.
oneLineZh: 以效果历史、视域融合和语言性把解释学从方法论扩展为哲学本体论。

oneLineEn: Connected Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Heidegger, and Arendt through Existenz, limit situations, and the Axial Age.
oneLineZh: 以生存哲学、界限处境和轴心时代思想连接克尔凯郭尔、尼采、海德格尔与阿伦特。

oneLineEn: Preserved ancient Pyrrhonism in the Outlines and Against the Professors, a hub for early modern skeptical revival.
oneLineZh: 以《皮浪主义纲要》和《反学者》保存古代皮浪主义，并成为近代怀疑论复兴的文本枢纽。

oneLineEn: Scholastic link between Aquinas and Ockham via univocity of being, formal distinction, and individuation theory.
oneLineZh: 以存在单义性、形式区别和个体性理论构成阿奎那与奥卡姆之间的经院哲学关键中环。

oneLineEn: Founding figure of Arabic philosophy uniting the Greek translation movement, first philosophy, and Islamic monotheism.
oneLineZh: 作为阿拉伯哲学源头人物，把希腊哲学翻译运动、第一哲学和伊斯兰一神论组织到同一项目中。

oneLineEn: Recast Ibn Sina, Platonic light metaphysics, and knowledge by presence into Illuminationist Islamic philosophy.
oneLineZh: 以照明哲学把伊本·西那传统、柏拉图主义光形而上学和临现知识改造成伊斯兰哲学新路线。

oneLineEn: Shaped Islamic mystical metaphysics via oneness of being, Perfect Human, imagination, and divine names.
oneLineZh: 以存在一性、完人、想象和神名理论塑造伊斯兰神秘形而上学，并深刻影响穆拉·萨德拉。

oneLineEn: Systematized late Warring States Legalism by uniting law, statecraft, power, and forms-and-names doctrine.
oneLineZh: 综合法、术、势与刑名之学，构成战国末期法家政治哲学的系统表达。

oneLineEn: Shaped Southern Chan via sudden enlightenment, self-nature, no-thought, and nondual samadhi-prajna (Platform Sutra).
oneLineZh: 以《坛经》中的顿悟、自性、无念和定慧不二塑造中国禅宗南宗经典形象。

oneLineEn: Founded Northern Song qi ontology through Great Void as qi, all people as siblings, and virtue cultivation practice.
oneLineZh: 以太虚即气、民胞物与和成德工夫奠定北宋道学气本论传统。
keywordsEn: all people as siblings, all things as companions

oneLineEn: Founded Buddhist pramana theory, limiting valid cognition to perception and inference, with apoha semantics.
oneLineZh: 以《集量论》奠定佛教量论，把有效认知限定为现量与比量，并提出遮诠语言理论。

oneLineEn: Critiqued Enlightenment gender order through women's rational education and civic equality.
oneLineZh: 以女性理性教育和公民平等批判启蒙时代的性别秩序。

oneLineEn: Helped revive virtue ethics through analysis of intentional action and critique of modern moral philosophy.
oneLineZh: 以意向行动分析和现代道德哲学批判推动德性伦理复兴。

oneLineEn: Countered totalizing systems in The Star of Redemption and opened a modern Jewish dialogical philosophy.
oneLineZh: 以《救赎之星》反击总体体系，并开出现代犹太对话哲学路线。

oneLineEn: Linked existentialism and postcolonial thought through colonial psychology and theories of national liberation.
oneLineZh: 以殖民心理分析和民族解放理论连接存在主义与后殖民思想。

oneLineEn: Founded critical pedagogy through dialogue, conscientization, and critique of banking-model education.
oneLineZh: 以对话、意识化和银行式教育批判奠定批判教育学。

oneLineEn: Recast Marxist social philosophy as a diagnosis of modernity via critical theory and critique of instrumental reason.
oneLineZh: 以批判理论和工具理性批判把马克思主义社会哲学改造为现代性诊断。

oneLineEn: Exposed social domination in identity thinking via negative dialectics, culture industry, and modernist aesthetics.
oneLineZh: 以否定辩证法、文化工业批判和现代主义美学揭示同一性思维中的社会支配。

oneLineEn: Remade media-critical modernity via art under mechanical reproduction, history, and urban fragment writing.
oneLineZh: 以机械复制时代艺术、历史哲学和城市碎片书写重塑现代性批判的媒介维度。

oneLineEn: Linked Kantian tradition to Rosenzweig via Marburg Neo-Kantianism and Jewish rational religion philosophy.
oneLineZh: 以马堡新康德主义和犹太理性宗教哲学连接康德传统与罗森茨维格。

oneLineEn: Pushed scholastic theology into German mysticism's core via detachment, poverty of spirit, and mystical union.
oneLineZh: 以离执、灵魂贫乏和神秘合一把经院神学推进到德语神秘主义核心。
keywordsEn: birth of God in the soul

oneLineEn: Moved medieval theology toward Renaissance metaphysics via learned ignorance, coincidence of opposites, and infinity.
oneLineZh: 以有学问的无知、对立相合和无限者问题把中世纪神学推向文艺复兴形而上学。

oneLineEn: Opened history, law, myth, and language as a human-made world through verum factum and the New Science.
oneLineZh: 以 verum factum 原则和《新科学》开出历史、法、神话和语言的人类自造世界。

oneLineEn: Critiqued abstract universalism via language, national spirit, and historical individuality; shaped German historicism.
oneLineZh: 以语言、民族精神和历史个体性批判抽象普遍主义，塑造德国历史主义与浪漫主义前史。

oneLineEn: Answered modernity's religion and self problems via self-philosophy, Islamic reconstruction, and poetic politics.
oneLineZh: 以自我哲学、伊斯兰思想重构和诗性政治想象回应现代性中的宗教与主体问题。

oneLineEn: Pushed post-Dignaga Buddhist epistemology to its Indo-Tibetan peak through pramana, logic, and apoha exclusion.
oneLineZh: 以量论、因明和语言排除论把陈那之后的佛教认识论推向印度与藏传传统的高峰。

oneLineEn: Remade Japanese Pure Land via other-power faith, grateful nembutsu, and ordinary-person awareness; founded Jodo Shinshu.
oneLineZh: 以他力信心、念佛感恩和凡夫自觉重塑日本净土传统，奠定净土真宗。
keywordsEn: the evil person as the true object

oneLineEn: Set Cheng-Zhu Learning via Heavenly Principle, investigation of things, and reverential cultivation; source for Zhu Xi.
oneLineZh: 以天理、格物和敬的修养论奠定程朱理学的核心方向，成为朱熹思想直接源头。

oneLineEn: Translated Chinese classical thought into 20th-c. problems via modern historiography and New Rational Philosophy.
oneLineZh: 以现代哲学史写作和新理学体系把中国传统义理转译为二十世纪哲学问题。

oneLineEn: Built modern New Confucian moral metaphysics from Kantian critique, intellectual intuition, and liangzhi theory.
oneLineZh: 以康德批判、智的直觉和儒家良知论建立现代新儒家的道德形上学。

oneLineEn: Joined mysticism, ethics, and modern political critique via attention, affliction, force, obligation, and rootedness.
oneLineZh: 以注意力、苦难、力量、义务和扎根思想连接神秘主义、伦理学与现代政治批判。

oneLineEn: A major source of Latin American Marxism via Peruvian reality, Indigenous land questions, and creative socialism.
oneLineZh: 以秘鲁现实分析、印第安土地问题和创造性社会主义构成拉丁美洲马克思主义的重要源头。

oneLineEn: Organized faith, reason, natural light, and ethical equality in the Hatata into Ethiopian rationalism.
oneLineZh: 以《探究》把信仰、理性、自然光和伦理平等组织为埃塞俄比亚理性主义传统。

oneLineEn: Extended Zera Yacob's rational inquiry into education, family, labor, and social responsibility.
oneLineZh: 承接泽拉·雅各布的理性探究，把自然理性推进到教育、家庭、劳动和社会责任问题。

oneLineEn: Early language for Pan-African thought via African personality, comparative religion, and educational critique.
oneLineZh: 以非洲人格、宗教比较和教育批判奠定泛非思想与非洲现代主体性的早期语言。

oneLineEn: Key post-independence African political philosopher via consciencism, Pan-African unity, and neocolonial critique.
oneLineZh: 以良知主义、泛非统一和新殖民主义批判构成独立后非洲政治哲学的重要节点。

oneLineEn: Major anti-liberal, anti-emotivist program in modern moral philosophy built on virtue, practice, and tradition.
oneLineZh: 以德性、实践和传统构成现代道德哲学中反自由主义与反情感主义的重要方案。

oneLineEn: Rejoined analytic philosophy, Deweyan tradition, and liberal democracy via anti-representationalism and neopragmatism.
oneLineZh: 以反表象主义和新实用主义把分析哲学、德威传统和自由民主文化重新连接。

oneLineEn: Remade late 20th-c. philosophy of language and metaphysics via modal logic, rigid designation, and naming.
oneLineZh: 以模态逻辑、刚性指称和命名理论重塑二十世纪后期语言哲学与形而上学。
